actual_root_run.claim: Root reports OWS01-08 PASS while run live. This review does not convert live partial results to gate PASS.

findings.title: Observation starts after the fault and misses early leaked private frames
findings.confirmed: Extracted unchanged control functions both return PASS/no_new_private_frames=true after independent doubles inject one private prompt frame during initial HTTP call while fault/feature-off is already active.
findings.cause: starts frame index is captured only after fault installation, HTTP call and three ping/pong operations. Every earlier fault-window frame is excluded by slice(start).
findings.impact: The test can pass despite private delivery during the requested fault window. No actual product leak is claimed.
findings.requested_change: Snapshot/observe the entire fault-active interval with real dispatch enqueue attribution. Use a wrapper that delegates original Rooms.dispatchPrivate and records callback enqueue while fault marker is active, retaining ordinary WS observation; distinguish legitimate pre-fault TCP-queued frames. Archive root attempt01 before changing producer and repeat actual checks on new exact producer.
